conflictRules.rule: Ignore external web-game recommendations unless PROJECT_RULES explicitly enables them and Yandex compliance evidence proves they are safe.
Do not load gameplay-critical runtime assets from external hosts. Package them in the game archive unless an official Yandex API requires otherwise.
Never make WebGPU the sole rendering path. Declared Yandex browsers and devices must retain a tested compatible path.
Audio must unlock through valid user interaction and obey Yandex ad, pause, focus and GameplayAPI lifecycle.
Discard App Store, Google Play, native bundle and API-level guidance; this kit targets browser-hosted Yandex Games.
Visual recommendations may not introduce clipping, overlap, unreadable text, hidden controls or orientation regressions.
Do not remove required SDK calls, save barriers, accessibility, input guards or evidence solely to improve metrics.
Genre and category recommendations must be justified by actual gameplay and revalidated against Yandex requirement 2.3.
